title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 19.0 up to but not including 19.4.11, 19.5 up to but not including 19.5.9, and 19.6 up to but not including 19.6.2 could allow an authenticated user with CI job access to obtain sensitive information belonging to another user. This issue occurs on instances with incoming email enabled due to improper scope validation. The vulnerability has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
